window: Past 24 hours. Search indexes lagged; only two verifiable new stories surfaced, both local US.

stories.headline: Colorado Springs narcotics unit dismantles trafficking group after five-month probe, seizing 188 pounds of meth and 37,000 fentanyl pills
stories.body: Four search warrants across El Paso County also turned up cash and three firearms. One suspect was arrested locally and another by a task force in New Mexico; police say six people are implicated and are still looking for co-conspirators.

stories.headline: Fresno man charged after allegedly carrying 4 kilograms of fentanyl into a restaurant to sell it
stories.body: Federal prosecutors say the 39-year-old was arrested at the restaurant on Wednesday, and a further 400 grams of fentanyl plus an AR-style rifle with a 70-plus-round drum magazine were found at his home. He faces a 10-year mandatory minimum on a possession-with-intent charge.
